decision: Replace one missing physical-reference-cost input with a source-, case-, configuration-, and host-scoped observation; do not decide reference qualification or Variant B.

case.source: Verified evidence/reference_audit.json records[0].case from the pinned archive; the current-environment generator replay is checked and any last-bit/digest mismatch is retained rather than substituted.
case.scope: First source-defined reference-audit case: periodic unforced positive-viscosity one-dimensional Burgers, harmonic family, lowest source-defined Reynolds-number cell. It is not representative of every regime.

dependencies.deviation: Network installation was not authorized. The probe uses an already-present environment within the source-declared supported ranges; it does not reproduce the source archive's saved exact evidence environment.

measurement.cold_definition: First ETDRK4 call after importing the verified source in a fresh process.
measurement.warm_definition: Subsequent identical ETDRK4 calls in that same process; each repeats the full calculation and is not a fresh scientific case.
measurement.serialization_definition: Write and reload the produced cold primary and refinement arrays as a compressed local NPZ artifact.
measurement.stop_condition: One selected case, one cold primary, two warm repeated primary calls, one refinement, two witness-node calls, diagnostics, serialization, and retrieval; stop on any failed required operation and retain the failure.

claim_limitations: The source methods and proposed limits are not scientifically qualified.
A one-case public CPU component probe is not an integrated C-EP1 exam or a protected-reference benchmark.
The observation does not measure JAX reconstruction, candidate inference, compatible miner demand, Variant-B overhead, custody, hostile-host integrity, production entropy, or exams per day.
The cold/warm repetitions measure repeated execution of one public case and do not create independent physical evidence.

The selected source-supported local dependency environment does not reproduce the archived generator's last-bit case digest; the numerical calls therefore use the archive's verified immutable case record and retain the replay mismatch.
Any shareable fraction remains conditional on identical reference identity, sampling, evidence, custody, and comparison requirements.
